verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no data-export feature, bulk export, or open-format dump for leaving Loops. The migration guides cover moving into Loops from Brevo and Customer.io, not out of it. API, MCP and CLI read access with JSON output are developer building blocks a user could use to build an export, not a first-party export-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Read and write contacts, events, and content from any client.
All commands support JSON output (-o json) for scripting
